title: Tao Heung Foods of Mankind Museum
geometryBasis: Two-storey height and surveyed envelope from LandsD, address cross-match to OSM and official lookup, and the unchanged October 2006 native photo first located through Qualla.
sectionBasis: The photographed light grey cantilever frames the recessed entrance wall. Lower masonry side panels, an open metal gate with darker insets, and the flanking stair runs read toward the street.
limitations: The model is the 2006 Fanling building. The present museum in Fo Tan is at a different address.
Unseen rear elevations, museum signage and fixtures are simplified. Temporary displays and the earlier interior exhibition are outside scope.
